name: cyc3-cancellation
comment: Not a GHZ graph, but an arithmetic fixture. The single feasible colouring (0,0,1,1) has three matchings of weights 1, z, z^2 with z = exp(2 pi i / 3), so its weight is 1 + z + z^2 = 0 exactly. Any checker that tests weights in floating point or forgets to reduce modulo Phi_3 gets this wrong.
